note: RETENTION WITHOUT A DECISION-GATED PIN. Operator-identified 2026-08-22. Every retained artifact needs TWO things: an automatic forgetting rule (clock/count/tier) AND a pin that survives it, RELEASED BY A DECISION rather than by time. No existing C0-C14 class covers it: C4 (honest-absence) governs how absence RENDERS once a thing is gone, not whether it should have been kept; C6a (bounded-work) bounds a sweep's budget, not an artifact's lifetime; C10 (contract-evolution honesty) governs a shape changing, not a body being forgotten. FIVE dated instances at DISTINCT seams, all verified on disk this session: (1) CI/Jenkins seam — buildDiscarder(logRotator(numToKeepStr)) live at 20/100/50/30/30 across five pipelines with ZERO keepLog pins repo-wide; Jenkins ships the pin and we run only the forgetting half. (2) memory-kit seam — memkit-retention.py's HEAD/TAIL/CORE comet has both halves, but its pin (TRAJECTORY.md spine) is AUTOMATIC, not decision-gated. (3) governance seam — .epr-meta retire-when: is a decision-gated pin for RULES, proving the shape is already understood one plane over; 6 manifests carry one. (4) habits seam — habits.yaml best_observed: pins a high-water mark against Meadows drift-to-low-performance, decision-gated in practice but undeclared as a class. (5) witness-ledger seam — governance-findings.jsonl measured 2.8MB (2026-08-05) then ~4.3MB (habits.yaml:1691) then 7,806,004 B (2026-08-22) with a repo-wide grep for a read path returning nothing; three surfaces flagged it and it grew through all three, because no forgetting rule and no pin exist for a ledger row. NOTHING IN THE REPO PINS A RESULT OR A LEDGER ROW. Consequence measured today: the 2026-08-22 artifact subtraction audit ruled 9 RETIRE-NOW items of which 4 were reversed by its own deletion-safety auditor and 5 more were found unsafe on independent verification, because 'should this be kept' had no declared answer to consult. NOT a mint request: this records the claim and its evidence per the ledger's own intake discipline. The natural home is concerns.yaml (Precedent-shaped, no evaluable predicate today) and canon-lift already projects such a row into mishpat_integrity::Precedent standing, where status/superseded_by IS release-by-decision-not-clock.
